classification_overrides.name: mobiclip_fastaudio_kernel
classification_overrides.reason: MobiClip FastAudio decoder (audio coding 2): hand-written ARM the audio dispatcher calls in place from .rodata. Semantic model tools/mobiclip_fastaudio.py; forced DeSmuME capture replayed byte-exact (KH Days streams use IMA ADPCM, so the game never reaches it).

classification_overrides.name: mobiclip_decoder_payload
classification_overrides.reason: Position-independent MobiClip decoder copied to fast memory and executed through a function pointer; do not treat a preserved blob as reconstructed DATA.

classification_overrides.reason: MobiClip deblocking post-filter: hand-written ARM the frame blitter calls in place from .rodata (display modes 1/2; KH Days uses mode 0). Semantic model tools/mobiclip_deblock.py; forced DeSmuME capture replayed byte-exact.
